hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 1; [ -t 0 ] || event=$(cat); build=$(cargo build --quiet --all-targets </dev/null 2>&1) || { printf 'detent: the tree does not build, so no gate ran (every stop blocks until it does):
%s
' "$build" >&2; : > .detent-build-blocked; exit 2; }; printf '%s' "$event" | cargo run --quiet -- gate --hook --changed
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; if [ -x target/debug/detent ]; then target/debug/detent guard; else cargo run --quiet -- guard; fi
